narrative:
Material PL1__M3813B21 exhibits erratic demand behavior with a coefficient of variation of 0.54. 
The demand pattern shows no significant trend over the analysis period, 
with 93.1% of working days having non-zero demand. The lead time demonstrates moderate 
variability (CV=0.37). After removing extreme outliers (values exceeding 12 days), 
the cleaned lead time data shows a mean of 4.07 days with standard deviation of 1.52 days.

The optimized inventory policy recommends a safety stock of 853 units to achieve the target service level 
of 95%, compared to the current SAP safety stock of 0 units. The recommended 
order quantity of 2016 units balances ordering and holding costs while respecting the minimum order quantity 
of 84 units and the maximum storage capacity of 2869 units.

This optimization is expected to increase total annual inventory costs by 
$2175.28 (37.2%) compared to the previous policy.

research_insights.selected_model: Stochastic Inventory Model with Variable Lead Time
research_insights.selection_rationale: Selected due to erratic demand pattern (CV=0.54) and moderate lead time variability (CV=0.37). The model accounts for both demand and lead time uncertainty using combined variance.
